description: Ring sales at 40 staffed lanes, 20 self-checkouts, and 5 service desks; authorize cards through the processor; print FACTA-compliant receipts
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $242,000 of store sales per day across 5 stores; customers abandon carts within minutes; offline mode covers card approvals for up to 24 hours only if registers and store servers run
manual_workaround: Offline (store-and-forward) card approvals under the floor limit; cash-only lanes; close self-checkouts first
dependent_systems: SYS-03; SYS-07; SYS-02; SYS-06 (back office only)
dependent_third_parties: Payment processor; POS vendor; SD-WAN provider; ISPs
quantified_operational_impact: About 6,400 baskets a day; a 4-hour outage at all stores affects about 1,700 baskets, of which about 40% are not recovered
quantified_regulatory_impact: Card data must stay protected in offline mode (encrypted store-and-forward files); FACTA truncation on any manual receipt
regulatory_or_contract_linkage: PCI DSS v4.0.1 (N44-45-R01); FACTA 15 U.S.C. 1681c(g) (N44-45-R05); merchant agreement

description: Accept SNAP EBT cards on the same PIN pads through the EBT processor
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $22,000 of SNAP purchases a day; EBT cannot be processed offline; households that rely on SNAP have no alternate tender
manual_workaround: Follow the EBT processor's outage procedure; hold orders for customers who can return; post notices at entrances
dependent_third_parties: EBT processor; payment processor; POS vendor
quantified_operational_impact: About 630 EBT transactions a day; after 8 hours about 340 are delayed
quantified_regulatory_impact: FNS retailer authorization depends on lawful program operation (7 CFR 278.1, 278.2); no specific outage rule identified

business_process: Online ordering and payment (website and app)
description: Customers browse, build baskets, and pay through the processor's hosted payment fields; orders flow to stores for picking
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $33,000 of online orders a day (about 390 orders); next-day slots fill the evening before; checkout page integrity is a card-data risk
manual_workaround: Phone orders for vulnerable customers paid at pickup on PIN pads; extend open slots; disable online card payment and take pay-at-pickup if the checkout page is suspect
dependent_systems: SYS-01; SYS-02; SYS-04 (loyalty API, integration platform); SYS-06
dependent_third_parties: E-commerce platform vendor; payment processor; marketing agency (tags)
quantified_operational_impact: About 195 orders lost or delayed in 12 hours; about 60% of them are not recovered
quantified_regulatory_impact: Checkout scripts must stay managed and monitored during recovery (PCI DSS 6.4.3, 11.6.1); breach clocks if the page was altered
regulatory_or_contract_linkage: PCI DSS v4.0.1 6.4.3 and 11.6.1 (N44-45-R01); FTC Act Section 5 (N44-45-R02)

business_process: Order picking, curbside pickup, and home delivery
description: Pickers use handhelds to pick orders; drivers deliver within about 12 miles; the app signals curbside arrival
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Orders are promised in 2-hour windows; perishables cannot wait more than a day
manual_workaround: Printed pick lists from the e-commerce admin console; phone customers on arrival; reschedule deliveries
dependent_third_parties: E-commerce platform vendor; delivery marketplace; mobile carrier
quantified_operational_impact: About 390 orders a day; manual picking takes about twice as long
quantified_regulatory_impact: None beyond refund and consumer protection rules
regulatory_or_contract_linkage: FTC Act Section 5 (accurate service and refund representations)

description: Maintain item and price files in the ERP; publish the nightly price file to registers, shelf labels, and the e-commerce platform; load weekly promotions
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Prices can run one day on the last file; weekly ads must match register prices
manual_workaround: Freeze prices on the last good file; manual overrides at registers for advertised items; pause online price changes
quantified_operational_impact: About 41,000 items; a missed weekly update affects about 1,200 promoted items
quantified_regulatory_impact: Advertised prices must match register prices; emergency pricing limits during a declared state of emergency (Fla. Stat. 501.160)

description: Receive supplier loads, pick store orders with RF handhelds in the WMS, and ship daily to 5 stores (fresh, frozen, and grocery)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Perishables have 1 to 3 days of shelf life; stores hold about 1 day of fresh product; empty shelves drive customers to competitors
manual_workaround: Paper pick lists from the last WMS extract; direct-store delivery from key suppliers; prioritize fresh and high-velocity items
dependent_systems: SYS-05 (WMS, ERP); SYS-07 (DC); SYS-10 (cold-room controls); SYS-08 (RF handhelds)
dependent_third_parties: WMS vendor; ERP vendor; refrigerated carriers
dependent_people_or_facilities: 65 DC and transportation staff; DC campus
quantified_operational_impact: About 120 store orders a week (about 2,300 cases a day); a 24-hour stop causes about $27,000 in lost sales, $25,000 in spoiled product, and $8,000 in overtime
quantified_regulatory_impact: Food safety temperature records must be kept for cold-chain product
regulatory_or_contract_linkage: Food safety records (cold chain); supplier contracts

description: Create purchase orders, exchange EDI documents with about 300 suppliers, and match receipts
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Supplier lead times are 1 to 5 days; a 2-day delay creates gaps a week later
manual_workaround: Phone and email orders to the top 40 suppliers; supplier-managed inventory for direct-store-delivery vendors

description: Refrigeration controllers and about 900 case sensors raise temperature alarms; staff record temperatures and discard unsafe product
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Unsafe product can reach customers within hours if a case fails unnoticed; about $40,000 of refrigerated and frozen product per store
manual_workaround: Manual temperature checks every 2 hours with paper logs; move product to backup coolers; refrigeration contractor on call
dependent_people_or_facilities: Fresh department staff; Store Managers; DC cold rooms
quantified_operational_impact: About 900 sensors and 62 controllers; manual checks need about 1 staff hour per store every 2 hours
quantified_regulatory_impact: Food safety rules require discarding temperature-abused product and keeping temperature records
regulatory_or_contract_linkage: Food safety records; insurance spoilage claims

description: Look up members at registers, apply personalized digital coupons, and record purchase history in the loyalty and CDP database
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Members expect their offers at checkout; complaints spike within a day
manual_workaround: Registers apply a standard store-wide discount for members; honor offers later through customer service credits
dependent_systems: SYS-04 (loyalty and CDP database, loyalty API); SYS-03; SYS-01
dependent_third_parties: Pricing and offers engine vendor; cloud provider
quantified_operational_impact: About 4,200 member transactions a day; about 1,900 offers redeemed a day
quantified_regulatory_impact: Privacy notice promises about member data; FTC deception exposure if data is misused
regulatory_or_contract_linkage: FTC Act Section 5 (N44-45-R02); Fla. Stat. 501.171 for member credentials

business_process: Supplier offers and retail media service
description: Set up supplier-funded offers and sponsored placements, report redemptions to about 140 suppliers through the reporting portal, and bill suppliers
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $3.1 million a year in supplier reimbursements and fees (about $8,500 a day); suppliers expect weekly reports; two national suppliers require SOC 2 Type 2
manual_workaround: Delay campaign launches; send manual redemption summaries from the data warehouse
dependent_systems: SYS-04 (reporting portal, data warehouse, CDP); SYS-12 (offers engine)
dependent_third_parties: Pricing and offers engine vendor; cloud provider
quantified_operational_impact: About 60 live campaigns a week; billing delayed about $60,000 a week
quantified_regulatory_impact: Supplier contracts require accurate, timely redemption data (SOC 2 Processing Integrity in P09)

description: Take catering orders by phone and in person; charge cards through the processor's virtual terminal on service-desk PCs
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 3,000 catering orders a year (about $2,000 a day); orders are placed days ahead
manual_workaround: Take payment at pickup on a PIN pad
dependent_people_or_facilities: Deli and bakery staff; service desks
quantified_regulatory_impact: Paper forms with full card numbers are a PCI DSS finding (gap 8); they must not be used as a workaround

description: Answer calls, emails, and chatbot handoffs about orders, refunds, and loyalty
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Online order problems need same-day answers
manual_workaround: Route calls to store service desks; website banner; extend refund windows
quantified_regulatory_impact: Card numbers must never be taken by phone or chat (POL-04)

business_process: Payment settlement, reconciliation, and cash office
description: Reconcile card and EBT settlements, chargebacks, cash deposits, and gift cards
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Settlements post daily; chargeback response windows run weeks
manual_workaround: Processor merchant portal reports; manual deposit logs
dependent_third_parties: Payment processor; EBT processor; armored car service
quantified_regulatory_impact: Chargeback deadlines under card brand rules (not verified)

description: Pay about 300 suppliers by ACH; change supplier bank details
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Supplier terms allow a few days; business email compromise targets bank detail changes
manual_workaround: Pay critical suppliers through the bank portal with dual approval
quantified_operational_impact: About $1.4 million a week in supplier payments

business_process: Payroll, scheduling, timekeeping, and HR (including hiring)
description: Biweekly payroll for 600 employees; store labor scheduling; applicant tracking with the hiring screening module (AI-006)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Hourly employees must be paid on time; high turnover needs continuous hiring
manual_workaround: Repeat prior payroll through the payroll provider; paper time sheets; manual applicant review
dependent_systems: Payroll and HR SaaS; SYS-06; SYS-12 (AI-006)
dependent_third_parties: Payroll and HR SaaS provider; applicant tracking vendor
quantified_operational_impact: 600 employees paid biweekly; about 40 applicants a week
quantified_regulatory_impact: Wage payment laws; Title VII for hiring decisions (P10)

description: Route DC trucks to stores and home delivery drivers to customers
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Daily truck schedules feed store receiving; home delivery windows
manual_workaround: Fixed routes from the last plan; phone dispatch
quantified_operational_impact: About 14 store deliveries and about 230 home deliveries a day

description: Data warehouse feeds forecasts (AI-002), sales reporting, and private equity sponsor dashboards
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Forecasts can run on last week's plan for several days
manual_workaround: Reuse the prior week's order quantities; ERP standard reports

business_process: CCTV, physical security, and loss prevention
description: Record video at stores and the DC; investigate theft and PIN pad tampering
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Recorders keep 30 days of video locally; investigations can wait days
manual_workaround: Guards and manager walk-throughs; preserve recorder drives
quantified_regulatory_impact: Video evidence for PIN pad tampering investigations (PCI DSS 9.5)
